summary: Eureka Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026 reporting receipt of a Nasdaq letter dated October 6, 2026 confirming regained compliance with the minimum 300 public holders requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(3); the matter is closed. No deal terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. The filing is a routine listing-compliance update signed by CEO Fen Zhang, not a special situation. Watch for any subsequent business-combination announcement, extension vote, or further listing deficiency.
